adjudicated.jp: 「気になってさ。特に意味はないよ」
adjudicated.en: Tomoki: "It just bothered me. Doesn't have to have meaning."
comments: See CCA0029. Interesting progress. The problem with this is another: this is Monday. That thing's been draping off for how long now? And it didn't matter before. The reason would be simple: the Club Room isn't being used that much anymore, and it's been a while since it has been in use serious enough to need the camouflage. And the same is simply true now. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Tomoki states that fixing it has no special meaning. The English instead says meaningfulness is not required, leaving open that it may have meaning.
adjudicated.remedy: There isn't any special meaning to it.
